messages:
mika_fin: Processor sent a batch CHB (chargeback) alert for yesterday's payouts. 12 chargebacks, 9 from the same acquirer BIN range, two different merchant account IDs. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/chargebacks/17921 :warning:

luis_payments: Do we have the dispute reason codes? Are they all 'fraud' or mixed? I'll check acquirer portal.

ops-bot: BatchAlert: CHB-BATCH-17921 detected. Dispute reasons: FRAUD(9), PRODUCT(2), OTHER(1). Related payout_ids: po_552, po_553. Export: /exports/chb/17921.zip

mika_fin: That FRAUD spike is concerning. Any overlap with the onboarding vendor that went live last week (vendor_aurora)?

luis_payments: cross-checking... 7 of the FRAUD chargebacks map to vendor_aurora merchant_id mg_aurora_01. Two map to mg_market_09. Pulling dispute docs now.

jess_legal: If it's a vendor-side issue (bad fulfillment / API leak) we need to freeze payouts to mg_aurora_01 and send preliminary notice. Legal to review chargeback packet before customer comms.

tara_support: Support queue shows 4 refund requests from customers referencing 'unauthorized subscription'. They all used the same promo code 'WELCOME2026'.

mika_fin: Promo code linked, vendor mg_aurora_01, and BIN range overlap. Looks like a coordinated test or card-testing led to fraudulent subscriptions.

luis_payments: Proposed actions: 1) place temporary payout hold on mg_aurora_01 2) request acquirer retrievals and chargeback evidence 3) rollback promo code 4) notify risk and vendor ops. Approve? :thumbsup: 

billing-bot: Auto-action: payout_hold applied to merchant mg_aurora_01. Holds: payouts suspended for 72h pending investigation.

jess_legal: Approve initial actions. I'll prep the vendor notice and embargoed comms. Do not contact customers until we have bank retrievals.

mika_fin: Thanks. Luis please post ETA. Also add a note to the merchant profile in the console: 'Chargeback pattern 17921 - vendor hold'.

luis_payments: ETA 2 hours for acquirer docs, 4 hours for full packet and decision recommendation. I'll update here. Closing loop: tag for postmortem and promo experiment review.
